mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called a Hertzian dipole whose importance is in the fact that many radiating systems are thought to be made up of large number of such dipoles."
The simple oscillating dipole is called a Hertzian dipole whose importance is in the fact that many radiating systems are thought to be made up of large number of such dipoles.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the medium for transmitting electromagnetic energy from one point to another."
A transmission line is the medium for transmitting electromagnetic energy from one point to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system of two equal but opposite charges separated by a short distance."
Recall that a dipole is a system of two equal but opposite charges separated by a short distance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Ampere's law modified by the addition of displacement current, dt dE o  when the electric field varies rapidly."
Note that equation (iv) is the Ampere's law modified by the addition of displacement current, dt dE o  when the electric field varies rapidly.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to waves whose wavefront are parallel to each other."
Plane waves refer to waves whose wavefront are parallel to each other.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system of two pairs of parallel conducting planes forming a rectangular hollow box."
Note that a waveguide is a system of two pairs of parallel conducting planes forming a rectangular hollow box.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a hollow infinite rectangular pipe of highly conducting material."
Rectangular waveguide is a hollow infinite rectangular pipe of highly conducting material.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a phenomenon in which a vibrating system responds with maximum amplitude to an alternating driving (external) force."
Resonance is a phenomenon in which a vibrating system responds with maximum amplitude to an alternating driving (external) force.
fib: ______ are used for the same purposes as transmission lines i.e. to transmit electromagnetic energy.
Waveguides
Waveguides are used for the same purposes as transmission lines i.e. to transmit electromagnetic energy.
______ is a complex resonant circuit which resonate when tuned to external radio signals picked by its aerial.
radio set
A radio set is a complex resonant circuit which resonate when tuned to external radio signals picked by its aerial.
______ is regarded as a cascade of infinite number of such circuits.
infinitely loss line
infinitely loss line is regarded as a cascade of infinite number of such circuits.
______ is a hollow rectangular metal pipe.
waveguide
The waveguide is a hollow rectangular metal pipe.
______ is the fundamental and important mode in the rectangular waveguide.
lowest TE mode
The lowest TE mode is the fundamental and important mode in the rectangular waveguide.
______ is the energy stored divided by Al where A is the cross sectional area of the solenoid and l its length.
energy density
energy density is the energy stored divided by Al where A is the cross sectional area of the solenoid and l its length.
______ is a medium having a similar property in all direction.
isotropic medium
An isotropic medium is a medium having a similar property in all direction.
